text: pl_migrate_policyclaims moves Thornridge's on-prem policy and claims data into Azure SQL without a weekend-long outage.

The pipeline runs in three moves: a one-time bulk Copy Activity through the Self-Hosted Integration Runtime, a watermark-driven incremental sync every fifteen minutes to keep both databases converging, and a short, scripted cutover.
The incremental sync pulls only rows changed since the last watermark, not a full re-copy, so the gap between on-prem and Azure narrows to minutes.
Before the final cutover, a row count and checksum comparison on every table confirms the two databases genuinely match, not just that the pipeline reported success.
The data is moving. Next: locking PolicyClaimsDB down with encryption, Azure AD authentication, and auditing before this goes live.
